The U.S. midterms will shape the political landscape for the next two years, while October nonfarm payrolls data will offer fresh clues on the health of the world's biggest economy.

Earnings from major tech and AI companies also come in as enthusiasm for the AI trade shows signs of fading.

Elsewhere, several major ‌central banks are due to meet, while investors continue to assess developments in key emerging markets, including Brazil and Indonesia.

Next are Reuters' five world market themes, re-ordered for equity traders—

(1) Tech Giant Apple Headlines This Week's Earnings Calendar

Apple , one of the "Magnificent 7" big tech giants, headlines the earnings calendar this afternoon, along with some stars in the AI galaxy later in the week.

The AI trade is in particular focus after disappointing results from Google parent Alphabet, Amazon and Intel triggered sharp share-price ‌declines.

Upcoming reports from Qualcomm and rival Advanced Micro Devices , could either reinforce or challenge concerns that investor enthusiasm for AI is losing momentum.

Over in Europe, investors will also hear from companies exposed to Trump's tariffs and higher energy prices stemming from the Iran war, including automakers BMW and Ferrari and airlines Deutsche Lufthansa and Ryanair .

(2) On Tuesday, the U.S. Midterm Elections Happen

Tuesday's U.S. midterm elections will determine whether Democrats can wrest control of Congress from President Donald Trump's Republican party, potentially reshaping the policy outlook for markets.

Democrats are widely expected to win the House of Representatives, while control of the Senate remains less certain. Republicans have controlled both chambers during Trump's first two years in office.

Should Democrats prevail, the prospect of tougher regulation on AI, including pushback on data center expansion, is on investors' radar, along with potentially greater scrutiny of Wall Street banks and crypto firms.

Story Continues

The outcome could also influence expectations for fiscal spending, while defense and healthcare stocks may be particularly sensitive to the result.

(3) Friday Morning, U.S. Federal Nonfarm Payroll Data for October Lands

Friday's October non-farm payrolls report caps a busy week for the U.S. economy and could provide fresh guidance on the Federal Reserve's next move.

September data showed the economy added a lower-than-expected +29,000 jobs.

The labor market has remained resilient. Unemployment stood at 4.2% last month, while weekly jobless claims are hovering near 57-year lows.

The Fed on Wednesday left rates unchanged and upgraded its assessment of the economy to "strong" from "solid."

Markets are pricing about an 80% chance of a Fed rate hike in December, reflecting some uncertainty over the timing of the next move. The payrolls number could bring some clarity.

(4) Trailing the FOMC Last Week, More Central Bank Meetings Happen

Another week brings another packed schedule of central bank meetings.

The Reserve Bank of Australia announces its policy decision on Tuesday, followed by Sweden's Riksbank on Wednesday and the Bank of England and Norges Bank on Thursday.

The Fed, European Central Bank and Bank of Japan all left policy unchanged this week, but markets expect the RBA, Riksbank and BoE to raise rates.

It would be the fifth increase this year for Australia's central bank as it battles stubborn inflation, but the first for Sweden and Britain.

Both have so far adopted a wait-and-see approach, but growing inflation risks are increasing the case for action.

Norway's central bank is further along the tightening path, having already raised rates twice this year.

(5) Brazil and Indonesia Central Banks Set Policy, Amidst Major Complications

Brazil's central bank faces a more complicated backdrop after a dramatic election campaign overturned market expectations.

Flavio Bolsonaro's first-round victory initially buoyed markets, but Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's comeback win in the runoff reversed those gains, sending the Brazilian real and equities sharply lower.

The political uncertainty has complicated an easing cycle that has brought interest rates down to 13.75%, making Wednesday's policy decision and accompanying guidance a key focus for investors. Markets will also be watching for Lula's choice of finance minister for signals on future fiscal policy.

In Indonesia, third-quarter GDP data due on Thursday will offer a fresh gauge of economic momentum.

With the rupiah near record lows, investors are looking for signs of strain in Southeast Asia's largest economy amid concerns over President Prabowo Subianto's policies and his ambitious 8% growth target.

news.Title: Google Recently Warned That Quantum Computers Could Crack Bitcoin. Now It's Selling Protection.
news.Content:
One day, it's technically possible that a hacker equipped with a quantum computer could crack the encryption that underpins Bitcoin (CRYPTO: BTC). That day may be drawing nearer; in March 2026, security researchers at Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOGL) estimated that a future quantum machine could break Bitcoin's wallet cryptography in less than 10 minutes, and that a quantum computer of sufficient power could be far easier to create than what had previously been believed. And now, on Oct. 28, Google Cloud previewed its new crypto custody system targeting banks that offer crypto products to their clients, positioning the quantum threat to Bitcoin as one of the risks that justify buying its services.

So what does this mean for Alphabet's stock, and what does this mean for Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies?

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 16x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

This move is aimed at cutting down on the biggest type of crypto theft

Google's new custody system is designed to protect crypto assets from one particular threat: theft of users' private keys.

In case you aren't familiar, a private key is the secret password that enables the control of a crypto wallet. According to Chainalysis data, hacked or otherwise illegally obtained private keys accounted for 43.8% of the crypto stolen in 2024.

Google's new service is called Multi-Party Compute (MPC), and it's useful for preventing that because it splits each private key into fragments which are then stored on separate systems, making it much more difficult to gain access to the keys by hacking individual networks or computers. Commercial launch of MPC is planned for early 2027.

But as of now, there's little reason to expect MPC to be very beneficial for Alphabet shareholders.

Per Alphabet's third-quarter earnings, Google Cloud revenue climbed 103% year over year to $30.7 billion, accounting for 24% of the company's total revenue. As there's no information available on the service's pricing yet, and plenty of other crypto custody options and cybersecurity services that appeal to institutional investors, it's unclear how the new initiative will capture much market share or generate much revenue at all.

And the entire endeavor's connection to quantum cybersecurity is, to some degree, a long shot; most timelines don't expect quantum computers that are powerful enough to be relevant to cryptocurrency encryption to even exist until five years from now at the earliest, and some estimates only see that happening after a decade or two.

Story Continues

Does Google's product make Bitcoin safer from quantum computers?

Aside from the above, it's also important for investors to temper their concerns (and expectations) for Google's involvement in the quickly evolving field of quantum cybersecurity.

In theory, sufficiently sophisticated quantum computers could crack Bitcoin's encryption and steal funds by working backward from a public key, which is a wallet's cryptographic identifier that is visible to everyone on the blockchain, to get to the private key behind it. An attack like that wouldn't need to steal any key fragments, so it isn't helpful to split the keys across systems like Google's approach does.

More than 6 million bitcoins, a substantial portion of the 21 million coins that can ever exist (almost 29%), are held in wallets with exposed public keys, and those are the coins that are most at risk as quantum computing companies improve the technology over the coming years. A successful attack would likely mean that Bitcoin would lose a dramatic amount of value overnight as holders fled to safer assets.

Furthermore, Google has given no timetable for when post-quantum cryptography, encryption built to resist quantum attacks, will be implemented in its service, though it's clearly on the agenda to develop at some point. So for now, the quantum security pitch is ahead of what the product can actually do as it's presently known and envisioned.

Alphabet investors can thus treat MPC as a small bonus for now, although it probably isn't worth loading up on the stock due to this new offering.

On the other hand, if quantum computers continue developing faster than anticipated, there could be a growing demand (and perhaps even a market panic causing a clamor) for a quantum-safe custody option, which Google would in turn be well positioned to deliver on, especially if its service gains some early traction in advance of that.

news.Title: ASML Surges 48% in the Past Year: How Should You Play the Stock Now?
news.Content:
ASML Holding N.V. ASML has gained 48.1% over the past year compared with the sector's growth of 9.5%. It has outperformed Advanced Energy Industries, Inc. AEIS but lagged Silicon Motion Technology Corporation SIMO. While AEIS has gained 11.4%, SIMO soared 103.6% over this period.

One-Year ASML Stock Price Performance

Image Source: Zacks Investment Research

ASML Rides on Strong AI Demand

ASML is benefiting from growing AI infrastructure investments, which are encouraging leading semiconductor manufacturers to expand their production capabilities. The company's Installed Base Management revenues reached €3.29 billion in the third quarter of 2026, increasing from €2.76 billion in the preceding quarter, driven by strong demand for productivity upgrades. New lithography system sales increased to 113 units from 86 in the second quarter.

Management highlighted improving order momentum, with some customers expressing interest in placing equipment orders for 2029 and 2030. The combination of capacity growth and higher lithography content gives ASML multiple structural avenues for revenue expansion through 2026 and beyond.

The company's dominant position in extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography technology provides a competitive advantage, particularly as chipmakers expand production of advanced logic and memory chips. ASML's expanding technological capabilities, strategic partnerships and improving financial outlook further strengthen its investment appeal. The company is advancing High Numerical Aperture (High-NA) EUV technology, which is expected to support next-generation semiconductor manufacturing and drive long-term equipment demand. Its expanding collaborations with Intel, Samsung and TSMC reinforce its position in advanced chipmaking.

Estimate Revision Trend

Earnings estimates for ASML for 2026 have moved up 54.4% to $46.54 over the past year, while the same for 2027 has increased 61.9% to $62.54. The positive estimate revision depicts bullish sentiment about the stock's growth potential.

ASML Growth Marred by Long Order Visibility

Despite the positives, management attributes the current demand environment primarily to AI-related investment and the resulting need for more advanced Logic and Memory capacity. This has produced unusually long order visibility for ASML, but it also makes the growth profile increasingly dependent on customers maintaining those expansion plans. A slower pace of customer investment would therefore affect both system demand and utilization of the larger production footprint ASML is preparing.

The planned scale-up requires manufacturing capacity, suppliers and trained employees to rise together. This leaves future profitability dependent on converting the larger cost base into the expected shipment volumes. Moreover, a uniform adoption schedule across Logic and DRAM customers is yet to be established. High-NA therefore remains both a technology opportunity and an execution variable, with the pace of wider insertion dependent on customer qualification and manufacturing decisions rather than ASML's roadmap alone.

Story Continues

Other Headwinds

ASML also faces operational challenges related to capacity expansion, supply-chain constraints and the growing complexity of its advanced lithography systems. In its third-quarter 2026 update, management indicated that planned production capacity for 2027 and 2028 would not fully meet anticipated customer demand, highlighting potential execution risks as the company scales manufacturing operations. Expanding capacity requires substantial investments, specialized components and a highly skilled workforce, while supplier bottlenecks could delay system deliveries and revenue recognition. In addition, developing and commercializing next-generation High-NA EUV technology requires significant R&D spending that could weigh on ASML's growth prospects.

End Note

ASML's technological leadership in EUV lithography, healthy order trends and expanding installed-base revenues reinforce its long-term investment appeal. With upward earnings estimate revisions, the stock is witnessing positive investor sentiment. However, export-control uncertainties, capacity-expansion challenges and long order visibility remain headwinds.

Stiff competitive pressure and supply-chain bottlenecks also plague the company's growth prospects. High operating and R&D expenses remain an overhang as well. With a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold), ASML appears to be treading in the middle of the road, and investors could be better off if they trade with caution. news.Title: The Zacks Analyst Blog Highlights AMD, NVIDIA, Broadcom and Intel
news.Content:
For Immediate Release

Chicago, IL – November 3, 2026 – Zacks.com announces the list of stocks featured in the Analyst Blog. Every day the Zacks Equity Research analysts discuss the latest news and events impacting stocks and the financial markets. Stocks recently featured in the blog include: Advanced Micro Devices AMD, NVIDIA NVDA, Broadcom AVGO and Intel INTC.

Here are highlights from Monday's Analyst Blog:

Buy, Sell or Hold AMD Stock? Key Tips Ahead of Q3 Earnings

Advanced Micro Devices is set to release its third-quarter 2026 results on Nov. 3.

AMD expects third-quarter 2026 revenues of $13 billion (+/-$300 million). At the midpoint of the revenue range, this represents year-over-year growth of 41% and 13% sequentially.

The Zacks Consensus Estimate for AMD's third-quarter revenues is pegged at $13.12 billion, suggesting year-over-year growth of 42%. The consensus mark for third-quarter 2026 earnings is pegged at $1.94 per share, up a couple of cents over the past 30 days. The earnings estimate indicates growth of 61.7% on a year-over-year basis.

AMD beat the Zacks Consensus Estimate for earnings in all the trailing four quarters, the average surprise being 6.74%.

Factors to Note Ahead of AMD's Q3 Results

AMD's third-quarter 2026 performance is likely to have benefited significantly from accelerating adoption of EPYC server processors across hyperscale cloud providers and enterprise customers. Growing AI inference and agentic AI workloads are driving demand for high-performance CPUs capable of managing data retrieval, workflow orchestration and AI processing tasks.

The company's fifth-generation EPYC Turin and fourth-generation EPYC Genoa processors have continued gaining traction across cloud and enterprise environments. The introduction of sixth-generation EPYC Venice processors, based on Zen 6 architecture and 2-nanometer technology, is expected to have strengthened AMD's competitive positioning.

The Data Center segment is likely to have benefited from increasing adoption of Instinct MI350-series GPUs across AI training and inference workloads. Demand for MI355X accelerators has strengthened as AI developers and cloud service providers expand deployments. The initial production shipments of AMD's Helios rack-scale AI platform, powered by MI450-series GPUs, EPYC Venice processors and Pensando networking, are also expected to have contributed to third-quarter revenues. However, Helios contributions are expected to have been relatively modest in the to-be-reported quarter.

Story Continues

AMD's Client business is likely to have benefited from continued Ryzen processor adoption, particularly across commercial notebooks, enterprise PCs and AI-enabled systems. Expanding adoption of Ryzen AI PRO 400-series processors across systems offered by Dell, HP, Lenovo and ASUS is expected to have supported market-share gains. Growing enterprise interest in local AI inference and AI-powered productivity applications may have provided additional opportunities for the Ryzen AI portfolio. Although management anticipated softer overall PC demand, AMD expected its Client business to outperform the broader market, supported by commercial customer adoption and product competitiveness.

Meanwhile, AMD's Embedded segment is expected to have aided third-quarter performance as demand recovered across networking, communications, aerospace and defense, test and measurement and industrial applications. The growing adoption of embedded x86 processors in data center networking and control-plane functions is likely to have strengthened the segment's growth trajectory.

The third-quarter profitability is likely to have benefited from a growing contribution from higher-margin EPYC server processors and a recovery in the Embedded segment. Increasing Data Center revenues are expected to have supported gross profit expansion, while rising scale across AMD's product portfolio may have improved operating leverage.

However, AMD continues to face stiff competition from NVIDIA , Broadcom and Intel . AMD faces intense competition from NVIDIA in AI accelerators and Intel in server and client processors. The growing adoption of internally developed AI accelerators by hyperscalers, along with Arm-based server processors, adds competitive pressure. Broadcom is increasing competitive pressure on AMD by strengthening its position in custom AI accelerators and high-performance networking for hyperscale customers.

AMD Stock Outperforms Sector & Peers

Advanced Micro Devices shares have surged 135.7% year to date (YTD), outperforming the Zacks Computer and Technology sector's return of 9.7%. The company's shares have outperformed Intel, NVIDIA and Broadcom YTD. Shares of Intel and NVIDIA have appreciated 78.2% and 9.8%, respectively, while Broadcom dropped 5.8%.

The AMD stock is not so cheap, as its Value Score of F suggests a stretched valuation at this moment.

In terms of the forward 12-month price/sales, AMD is currently trading at 10.27X, higher than the sector's 5.17X, NVIDIA's 8.03X and Intel's 4.85X, but lower than Broadcom's 14.64X.

AMD Rides on Strong Portfolio Amid Stiff Competition

AMD is positioned to capitalize on accelerating investments in AI infrastructure as hyperscalers, cloud providers and enterprises expand AI training, inference and agentic computing capabilities. The company expects the Data Center AI accelerator market to reach approximately $1.4 trillion by 2030, growing at an annual rate exceeding 45%. Increasing demand for GPUs, server CPUs and networking solutions provides AMD with a substantial opportunity to expand its presence across AI infrastructure. The company expects Data Center segment revenues to more than double year over year in 2027, supported by the increasing scale of AI deployments and strong demand for EPYC processors.

AMD's transition toward integrated rack-scale AI infrastructure represents a significant long-term growth catalyst. The Helios platform combines MI450-series GPUs, EPYC Venice CPUs, Pensando networking and ROCm software to deliver competitive AI inference performance and economics. The company expects substantial Helios shipment growth beginning in the fourth quarter of 2026 and accelerating throughout 2027.

Strategic relationships with OpenAI, Meta and Anthropic provide multi-generation deployment opportunities, while Microsoft's Azure adoption broadens AMD's presence among major cloud providers. Beyond Helios, the planned MI500-series GPU platform, along with Verano CPUs and next-generation networking technologies, is expected to strengthen AMD's ability to compete for increasingly complex AI workloads.

Conclusion

AMD's strong AI infrastructure portfolio, accelerating EPYC adoption and expanding hyperscaler partnerships position it well for long-term growth. However, stiff competition from NVIDIA, Broadcom and Intel, alongside a stretched valuation, remains a concern.

Moreover, the stock's impressive year-to-date rally suggests that much of the optimism surrounding its AI growth prospects may already be priced in. Investors should therefore adopt a cautious approach and wait for greater clarity on the Helios ramp and earnings growth before taking fresh positions in AMD stock.

AMD currently has a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold). You can see the complete list of today's Zacks #1 Rank (Strong Buy) stocks here.

news.Title: A Once-in-a-Decade Opportunity: 1 Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stock to Buy Before It Soars 60%, According to Wall Street
news.Content:
Artificial intelligence (AI) stocks have generated tremendous growth for investors over the past few years. This period represented the early part of the AI boom, as large language models were trained, fueled by powerful chips, and we began to see the potential of AI. Investors rushed to get in on shares of these companies, aiming to bet on technology that would reshape industries and our daily lives.

Over the past year, however, investors have become more cautious about AI stocks. As tech giants from Amazon to Alphabet spend hundreds of billions of dollars on an infrastructure build-out, investors question whether this spending is sustainable and worthwhile considering the future revenue opportunity. This sentiment has weighed on AI stocks this year, causing ups and downs for some and even declines for others.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 16x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

But this moment of uncertainty also means that certain high-quality AI stocks, ones with bright long-term outlooks, are now trading at reasonable or even cheap valuations. With this in mind, let's check out one of these once-in-a-decade buying opportunities. Here's one AI stock to buy before it soars 60%, according to Wall Street.

A triple-digit gain over three years

This particular stock climbed more than 300% over the past three years, but this year, it's only advanced about 9%. Meanwhile, this player's earnings continue to roar higher. I'm talking about Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA). This tech giant was the star of the earliest stage of the AI boom because its AI chips, known as graphics processing units (GPUs), were the first to market and demonstrated their speed and efficiency. As rivals joined the space, Nvidia's commitment to innovation kept it a step ahead.

Since, the company has added a wide range of products and services to its portfolio, making itself the "go-to" place for anything AI. Nvidia has also developed platforms to serve the needs of specific industries, such as drug development for biotech and pharma companies. And Nvidia has expanded its presence in the AI field, most recently offering to buy the open-source AI platform Hugging Face.

Nvidia's work in AI has resulted in explosive growth in revenue and profit, particularly compared to levels many years ago -- when its GPUs primarily served the video gaming market.

Story Continues

NVDA Revenue (Annual) data by YCharts

And this has continued through the latest quarter, when Nvidia reported a 100% increase in revenue to $96 billion and a triple-digit gain in net income to $59 billion.

Tech giants' spending on AI

But as I mentioned above, general concerns about tech spending on AI have held Nvidia stock back from the increases investors had grown accustomed to in the earlier stages of the AI boom. The idea is that if cloud giants see that investments aren't translating into strong enough growth, they may slow spending. That could hurt Nvidia's revenue, particularly considering data center makes up more than 90% of it.

Against this backdrop, however, analysts remain optimistic. The average Wall Street estimate calls for a 60% increase in Nvidia stock over the coming 12 months.

Now, here's why I think such a gain is possible. First, Nvidia today is trading at 21x forward earnings estimates, which is a bargain for a company with such market leadership , a solid track record of earnings growth, and long-term prospects that remain positive. Investors may jump to get in on this opportunity.

And this brings me to my second point, and that's the long-term AI story. It's very possible that growth may ebb and flow, and any slowdown could weigh on the stock. But, over time, revenue growth should be significant considering the capabilities of AI and the fact that its rollout to address real-world problems is just beginning. Companies will clearly continue to apply this technology to their situations in order to gain in efficiency, reduce costs, and become more innovative.

All of this means Nvidia stock, well positioned for gains, may be a once-in-a-decade buy right now.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 14x Bigger

Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005.

But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout, a massive technology build-out that Google's CEO says could be more profound than fire or electricity.

While everyone watches the chip designers, one "backbone" company provides the critical technology that Nvidia and AMD literally cannot function without. We've detailed this under-the-radar player in our new AI Playbook.

Continue »

news.Title: Are Wall Street Analysts Bullish on QUALCOMM Stock?
news.Content:
San Diego, California-based QUALCOMM Incorporated (QCOM) operates as a multinational semiconductor and telecommunications equipment company. With a market cap of $176 billion, the company develops and delivers digital wireless communications products and services based on CDMA digital technology.

Shares of this semiconductor and equipment giant have underperformed the broader market over the past year. QCOM has declined 10.4% over this time frame, while the broader S&P 500 Index ($SPX) has rallied nearly 10.3%. In 2026, QCOM stock is down 5.2%, compared to the SPX's 10.2% rise on a YTD basis.

Narrowing the focus, QCOM's underperformance is also apparent compared to the State Street SPDR S&P Semiconductor ETF (XSD). The exchange-traded fund has gained about 25% over the past year. Moreover, the ETF's 36.9% gains on a YTD basis outshine QCOM's single-digit losses over the same time frame.

QCOM shares have underperformed due to mounting industry headwinds, including sluggish consumer demand in the core smartphone market and shifting premium chip mixes. Profitability is further squeezed by rising input costs for wafers, memory, packaging, and testing, alongside a sharper-than-expected loss of revenue as Apple Inc. (AAPL) accelerates its transition toward in-house modems.

For the current fiscal year, ending in September, analysts expect QCOM's EPS to fall 23.4% to $7.71 on a diluted basis. The company's earnings surprise history is mixed. It beat or matched the consensus estimate in three of the last four quarters while missing the forecast on another occasion.

Among the 34 analysts covering QCOM stock, the consensus is a "Moderate Buy." That's based on 10 "Strong Buy" ratings, two "Moderate Buys," 18 "Holds," one "Moderate Sell," and three "Strong Sells."

This configuration is more bullish than a month ago, with a "Hold" rating overall, consisting nine analysts suggesting a "Strong Buy."

On Oct. 25, Bernstein analyst Stacy Rasgon maintained a "Hold" rating on QCOM and set a price target of $165, implying a potential upside of 1.8% from current levels.

The mean price target of $199.38 represents a 23% premium to QCOM's current price levels. The Street-high price target of $400 suggests an ambitious upside potential of 146.8%.

news.Title: Want Decades of Passive Income? Start With This 1 Magnificent ETF.
news.Content:
Look at the iShares Core Dividend Growth ETF (NYSEMKT: DGRO) and the first number you'll likely see isn't that impressive.

Its current dividend yield is 2.1%, roughly double that of the S&P 500 (SNPINDEX: ^GSPC), but also well below that of more popular funds, such as the Schwab U.S. Dividend Equity ETF (NYSEMKT: SCHD). And certainly well below what you'll find in the fixed-income exchange-traded fund (ETF) universe.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

It may not be a good candidate for someone looking for high income . But that misses the purpose of the portfolio. Its focus on dividend growth and balance sheet quality makes it ideal for someone looking to build a well-rounded dividend portfolio.

The yield isn't the important number

It's tempting to just buy a series of high-yield equity ETFs and capture the larger dividend checks. If you do that, however, you're creating portfolio vulnerabilities:

The portfolio sector compositions probably have a lot of overlap, particularly overweights in financial and energy stocks.

Pure high-yield strategies can introduce yield traps, or artificially high yields due to share price drops, or stocks at risk of a dividend cut.

The iShares Core Dividend Growth ETF doesn't consider a stock's yield at all. Qualifying companies must have raised their dividend for at least five straight years and have a payout ratio of less than 75%. The highest-yielding 10% of dividend stocks are also automatically eliminated from consideration and help to improve overall portfolio quality.

One unique aspect of the fund is its weighting method. It allocates according to total dividend dollars paid, not market cap or yield. In other words, the companies that pay out the most dividends get larger weights in the index. That gives it a natural tilt toward large caps over smaller companies, but it's a dividend-focused metric that works for this type of fund.

Why DGRO works so well in a portfolio

The iShares Core Dividend Growth ETF launched in June 2014. Since then, it's increased its total annual dividend paid every year. That's exactly the kind of track record you want to see in a dividend growth ETF. Over the past decade, it's grown its dividend by nearly 9% a year. So these aren't just minor dividend increases. They're fairly sizable ones that do a great job of staying ahead of inflation and improving real dividend income.

Story Continues

It's also delivered on total return. Since inception, it's returned almost 13% per year and carries a four-star rating from Morningstar .

The 2.1% yield won't be the income driver of your portfolio. But its focus on dividend growth and quality makes it a great complement to a high-yield ETF. Its track record of annual dividend increases makes it very attractive to income seekers and really anyone looking to add a quality fund to their portfolio.

news.Title: Apple showed once again that consumers will complain — but still tap to pay
news.Content:
Apple jacks prices? Consumers tap Apple Pay.

It's not easy forking over more than $1,000 for a new iPhone every couple of years. But Apple ( AAPL ) has proved yet again that complaining about prices isn't the same thing as being unwilling to make the purchase.

The company reported its quarter on Monday after the bell, posting revenue that grew 12% last quarter and beating Wall Street's expectations. The company also beat on earnings per share.

Apple's muscular iPhone sales are a microcosm of one of the major forces that have powered the economy. Though people may be furious with rising prices, the indefatigable American consumer continues to tap-to-pay through the rage.

Contributing, in all likelihood, to more inflation.

The news that higher costs may not deter customers should come as a relief to Apple investors, whose company is on a hardware blitz under new CEO John Ternus . The first quarter that captured sales from the new iPhone 18 lineup showed revenue grew 17% compared to the same period last year.

That included Apple's $100 iPhone price hike. (For other products like the MacBook Pro, the company passed its memory chip costs to consumers to the tune of $300.)

Initial analyst reactions to Apple's price-dictating cachet were triumphant.

"The debate into the print [data release] was the shape of the iPhone 18 cycle, and a 17% iPhone print with a 47.9% gross margin is a direct answer to the component order cut and memory cost worries," wrote Dan Ives of Yorkshire Ives in a note after earnings.

While Apple has particular pull as a marquee hardware designer, the pricing dynamics reflect a broader economic reality. Consumers have faced stubborn inflation, tech component shortages, and supply chain hiccups for years.

And they've learned to grudgingly tolerate higher costs, especially when it comes to tech products, or miss out on the latest upgrade cycle.

Follow Hamza Shaban on X @hshaban .

news.Title: Apple just made twice as much free cash as Microsoft, Meta, Alphabet and Amazon combined: Chart of the Day
news.Content:
Apple ( AAPL ) just had the biggest cash year in its history, and it didn't need to build a fleet of AI data centers to get there.

The iPhone maker generated about $136 billion in free cash flow — the cash left over after running the business and paying for buildings and equipment — in its fiscal year ended in September, according to its results Monday . That's up about 38% from a year earlier and well above its previous record of about $111 billion in 2022.

It's also roughly twice what Microsoft ( MSFT ), Meta ( META ), Alphabet ( GOOGL ) and Amazon ( AMZN ) made combined over their latest four quarters, by Yahoo Finance calculations.

The difference is the shopping list.

Those four companies spent more than $600 billion on capital expenditures over the past four quarters, much of it on AI chips and the data centers to house them. Apple spent about $9 billion in its fiscal year. That's down nearly 30% from a year earlier.

That bill is now showing up in their cash. Amazon has burned through about $42 billion over the past year, a record . Alphabet's free cash flow turned negative in the third quarter, and the stock just had its worst month ever . Meta's went negative for the first time since 2012.

Apple, meanwhile, brought in about $145 billion from its operations on record revenue of about $479 billion.

"We generated $28 billion in operating cash flow during the quarter, allowing us to return $28 billion to shareholders," CFO Kevan Parekh said in the release.

For the full year, Apple handed back about $102 billion through buybacks and dividends. Even that couldn't keep up, so the pile kept growing. Net cash — cash and investments minus debt — rose to about $57 billion from about $34 billion a year earlier.

The September quarter was the slow one. Operating cash flow came in slightly below a year ago.

Wall Street has noticed. Apple has become the market's hedge against the AI trade , and the stock was up about 25% this year through Nov. 2. Amazon, Microsoft, Meta and Alphabet ranged from a loss of about 11% to a gain of about 6%.

Apple isn't sitting out AI. Parekh said on the call that Apple will "significantly increase our overall investments in AI," mostly through research and development. He also said the cloud costs of running its new Siri will show up in what it spends to deliver its services. Asked whether Apple's spending was cooling after a heavy year, Ternus didn't budge. "We feel confident that we're spending what we need to spend to achieve our roadmap," he said.

news.Title: US stock futures mixed as Apple slides, midterms loom
news.Content:
Nov 3 (Reuters) - US stock index futures were mixed on Tuesday as crude oil prices ticked up and markets awaited the midterm elections results, while Apple joined the list of Big Tech companies whose results failed to ‌impress investors.

Apple fell 4.5% in premarket trading after the company warned the cost of memory chips would continue to rise, ‌pressuring its holiday-quarter gross margin.

AI-powered analytics software provider Palantir Technologies forecast revenue above estimates for the last three months of the year after topping third-quarter expectations. Its ​shares, however, fell 6.3%.

The Nasdaq-100 closed more than 10% lower from its all-time closing high on Monday, confirming that the tech-heavy index has entered a correction as investors grow wary of Big Tech's soaring AI spending and little evidence of adequate returns.

Several tech companies have also tapped the bond market to finance big AI investments recently, amplifying concerns that debt-funded spending will become harder to justify as borrowing costs rise.

At 05:06 ‌a.m. ET, Dow E-minis were down 219 ⁠points, or 0.42%, and S&P 500 E-minis were up 1.5 points, or 0.02%. Nasdaq 100 E-minis were up 130.5 points, or 0.46%.

Helping offset some losses among tech stocks was a rise in most chip stocks. ⁠Nvidia climbed 1.6% after falling for the last four sessions. Following the recent heavy losses in Nvidia, Apple surpassed the chip designer to become the world's most valuable company last week.

AMD gained 2.8% ahead of its quarterly earnings due after the bell, while Marvell Technology and Intel were also ​moving ​higher.

MIDTERMS RESULTS AWAITED

American voters will deliver a verdict on the first two ​years of President Donald Trump's second term in Tuesday's ‌midterm elections, with polls and nonpartisan analysts favoring Democrats to wrest the House from Republicans, while the control of the Senate remains uncertain.

"Concerns around government spending and deficits have continued to build, contributing to market volatility," Societe Generale analysts said in a note.

"However, any meaningful fiscal expansion would still require extensive negotiation, and with Democrats likely to gain control of the House, the legislative backdrop could become more gridlocked."

Morgan Stanley analysts said in a note earlier this week that the elections should help remove a major market overhang. They believes ‌the US market correction that began in June was in its "final innings".

Another risk ​factor could be the US renewing attacks on Iran after the midterms, something ​that Trump has hinted about in recent weeks. J.P. ​Morgan analysts said in a note earlier this week that they view any dip in the markets, due ‌to geopolitical tensions, as a buying opportunity.

Story Continues

However, when asked ​by reporters on Monday if he ​was considering striking Iran after the midterms, Trump said "no."

Crude oil prices rose on Tuesday after slumping in the previous session, as an Iranian official said a deal to end the war was far off, while the United States struck Iran's ​Qeshm Island.

Meanwhile, the earnings season remained in full ‌swing. Drugmaker Pfizer, agribusiness Archer-Daniels-Midland and oil refiner Marathon Petroleum were set to report before the bell.

Semiconductor test equipment ​maker Aehr Test Systems gained 14.6% and broadband solutions provider Harmonic added 16.1% after the companies raised their full-year ​revenue forecasts.

(Reporting by Shashwat Chauhan in Bengaluru; Editing by Shinjini Ganguli)

news.Title: Google Parent Alphabet Just Hit a Major Milestone, and It Has Nothing to Do With Its $482 Billion Single-Session Loss
news.Content:
It's Election Day in America, but it's also the heart of earnings season on Wall Street. Earnings season is the roughly six-week period each quarter when the lion's share of public companies report their operating results. Through the end of November, Wall Street's largest businesses will be lifting the hood on their third-quarter performance.

Last week, several members of the " Magnificent Seven " reported their operating results for the September-ended quarter, including Google parent Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL)(NASDAQ:GOOG). While Alphabet's eye-popping single-session decline has made all the headlines, it's a separate milestone that deserves all the attention .

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 16x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

Image source: Getty Images.

Alphabet just registered the second-largest single-day loss in Wall Street's storied history

"Yikes" might be the first word that comes to mind, with Google's parent company shedding more than $41 per share and losing a staggering $482 billion in market value in a single trading session on Oct. 29. It's the second-largest single-session loss in Wall Street's history, trailing only the $593 billion that the face of the artificial intelligence (AI) revolution, Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA), shed in one day last year.

Furthermore, the nearly 13% decline for Alphabet stock represented its worst single-day percentage loss since going public in 2004.

This negative reaction stems from Alphabet's aggressive investments in AI infrastructure. Whereas Alphabet typically generates more net cash from operations than it knows what to do with, its massive data center investments led to negative free cash flow of $9.1 billion for the September-ended quarter.

Additionally, Google Search and other revenue totaled roughly $63.4 billion, a 12% increase from the comparable year-ago quarter. While double-digit sales growth probably sounds great, it marks the second consecutive quarter that Google's search revenue fell short of Wall Street analysts' expectations.

Google parent Alphabet just hit a milestone with massive significance

But despite the sour reaction in Alphabet stock in the wake of this report, the company did hit a long-awaited major milestone.

For decades, Google Search has been the company's dominant revenue producer and cash cow. According to GlobalStats, Google accounted for a whopping 90% of global internet search traffic in September. Being this dominant affords Google (and its parent) exceptional ad-pricing power.

Story Continues

During the third quarter, the roughly $63.4 billion in sales generated by "Google Search and other" accounted for less than 50% of Alphabet's net quarterly sales ($127.6 billion) for the first time in its history!

Make no mistake about it: the cash flow generated from Google Search remains critical to Alphabet's bottom line and its AI data center build-out. There's no question that internet search traffic will be foundational to the company's ongoing profits.

However, Alphabet has officially turned the corner with regard to its AI ambitions. Sales for the world's No. 3 cloud infrastructure services platform by total spending, Google Cloud, surged 103% in the third quarter to an annual run rate of nearly $123 billion. Since integrating generative AI and large language model capabilities into Google Cloud, revenue for this segment has skyrocketed.

More importantly, margins for this AI-driven cloud infrastructure services platform are considerably higher than what Google generates from advertising through internet search.

Although it's difficult to look beyond Alphabet's otherworldly AI capital expenditures at the moment, its latest milestone holds massive significance concerning its future cash flow generation.

news.Title: Why I Still Wouldn't Buy Nike Stock in November
news.Content:
As the 2026 investing year winds down, more investors are analyzing their portfolios and preparing for 2027. For some investors, it may mean cutting positions or making sure they aren't overly concentrated in one specific area.

Others may be worried they have too many growth stocks and not enough income stocks. With Nike 's (NYSE: NKE) dividend yielding a respectable 4.2%, it may seem like a good addition to a portfolio. However, a closer look reveals more considerations are needed than just yield.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

What is hiding behind that strong yield

When CEO Elliott Hill, a longtime Nike veteran who joined the company in the late 1980s as a sales representative intern, took over in 2024, he had his work cut out for him. Nike had made a series of missteps over the years, ranging from shunning wholesalers to failing to keep up with changes in consumer tastes.

A finalized turnaround under Hill, however, hasn't quite happened. For its fiscal 2027 first-quarter earnings, Nike reported revenue of $11.2 billion, down 4% from the prior-year period. Along with that drop in overall revenue, Nike also saw its net income decrease 2% to $712 million.

Adding more woes to the rough quarter, Nike announced a restructuring plan expected to lead to layoffs and forecast that 2027 full-year revenue will fall by a high-single-digit percentage. With the stock price down around 39% so far in 2026, there don't appear to be any immediate catalysts to reverse those losses. With that gloomy full-year 2027 sales forecast, Nike doesn't seem likely to beat analyst estimates or be in a position to boost its outlook anytime soon.

That said, as much as Nike's sales have been an issue, there's also a brewing issue of expectations that could continue to weigh on the stock. There's a perception problem with Nike, and the market still hasn't quite caught on that the iconic retailer may need to be reevaluated.

The overlooked transformation

With Nike's sales struggles and declining stock price making most of the headlines, another story has quietly been forming in the background. Wall Street may be waiting for Nike to return to growth-stock status and post the same type of revenue increases as it did in the fourth quarter of 2021, when sales increased by 96%, but the iconic retailer is actually becoming more of a dividend stock .

Story Continues

It may sound surprising, but Nike hasn't just paid a dividend for the last 24 years; it's increased it every year over that period. That doesn't earn it the title of a Dividend King yet, as the company would have needed to increase that payout for 50 or more consecutive years , but it is decently far along the path to becoming one.

On Nike's earnings call for the first quarter of 2027, an analyst asked about the "priority" of the dividend "given the investment needs in the business." CFO Dave Denton emphasized the importance of dividend payouts:

First and foremost, let me hit that right off the gate. Dividend is a very significant priority for us here at Nike. It is a significant priority from the capital allocation program. And under all scenarios, we have support for maintaining and ultimately growing the dividend over time. So just we can put that to bed with that statement.

Why Nike stock still isn't a buy in November 2026

Eventually, Nike could be worth investing in as an income-generating asset if it can stabilize its slumping sales, which could help revive investor enthusiasm and give the stock price some fuel to climb higher. It doesn't have to return to 96% revenue growth in a quarter, but even modest sales growth would be welcomed at this point.

That said, if the markets continue to view Nike as a growth stock, its price may decline or remain stagnant for some time. And if the stock price keeps declining, that just lacks the stability income stocks are supposed to offer and starts to negate those dividend payouts. That's why, despite the appealing yield, the consistent increases in payouts, and the company's stated commitment to keep boosting the dividend, I still wouldn't start or add to a Nike position in November or for the rest of the year.

news.Title: The Company Behind the New York Stock Exchange Is Now Building on Hyperliquid. Here's What It Means for Investors.
news.Content:
The company behind the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE), Intercontinental Exchange (NYSE: ICE), will launch a new market for perpetual futures built on Hyperliquid (CRYPTO: HYPE), per an announcement on Oct. 29. While no launch dates have yet been set, and financial regulators still need to give the go-ahead, this marks a tremendous victory for Hyperliquid and its bid to become integrated with the traditional financial system, which may explain why the coin was up 18% during the prior seven days.

That might prove to be just an appetizer. Here's what this huge new development means for investors.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

TradeXYZ already runs 97% of Hyperliquid's third-party markets

Per the deal, ICE will operate a new, regulated U.S. market for perpetual futures contracts, built on Hyperliquid's blockchain and developed by TradeXYZ, a company closely linked to Hyperliquid. ICE will also take a minority stake in TradeXYZ, pending the necessary regulatory approvals.

Taken together, this means that ICE's new derivatives exchange is going to be one more vehicle by which Hyperliquid gets exposure to the growth of the perpetual futures market in the U.S.

Perpetual futures, or perps, are Hyperliquid's bread and butter for generating revenue, and they're essentially derivative contracts that track an asset's price and never expire. They resemble ordinary futures contracts and usually involve leverage. During the 30-day period ended Oct. 30, about $217.2 billion in perpetuals changed hands on Hyperliquid's exchange, generating $64.1 million in revenue.

As a business, TradeXYZ only operates on Hyperliquid and offers perps on stocks, indexes, commodities, and even other currencies. To do that, it launches its perps markets through HIP-3, a Hyperliquid feature that lets anyone who stakes 500,000 HYPE coins (about $46.5 million as of Oct. 30) deploy their own markets. TradeXYZ currently holds 97% of the $4.1 billion in open interest (the value of contracts outstanding) across Hyperliquid's third-party markets, so it's a dominant player in its niche.

In terms of economics, perps market developers like TradeXYZ are entitled to keep 50% of the transaction fees generated by their markets on Hyperliquid's network. And Hyperliquid funnels all but a couple of percentage points of those fees into making open-market purchases of its own coin, much like an automatic stock buyback.

Story Continues

In other words, if this deal enables ICE to launch many new, deep perps markets for its own users, it will be extremely positive for Hyperliquid as long as that U.S. activity continues to pay fees into Hyperliquid's system. Thus, it's almost certain that U.S. activity will feed Hyperliquid's fees and buybacks even with half the fee income going to TradeXYZ.

The ICE deal is just the latest

ICE isn't the only regulated venue operator lining up to use Hyperliquid.

Payward, the parent company of the Kraken crypto exchange, said on Sept. 16 that it intends to offer its U.S. clients perps using Hyperliquid's HIP-3 builder markets, starting with markets run by its Commodity Futures Trading Commission-regulated exchange, Bitnomial.

Moreover, having two separate regulated routes into the U.S. perpetuals markets raises Hyperliquid's odds that at least one will be approved. Of course, its competitors are also doing their best to get approved in the U.S., so it's important to remember that the perpetuals market will remain contested even if Hyperliquid manages to enter it.

Overall, this development indicates that Hyperliquid is well positioned to continue growing and that it's a platform serious enough to attract major players to use its backend for their own activities. And, as third-party market deployers fund their own markets, Hyperliquid doesn't even need to make significant capital investments to keep expanding.

If that's not bullish, not much else is.

news.Title: IonQ vs. Rigetti Computing: Which Is the Better Quantum Computing Stock to Own for the Next 5 Years
news.Content:
Investors are always on the lookout for the next big thing in technology, and this time around, it may be quantum computing. It offers us an enormous step up from classical computing, allowing us to solve many of today's impossible problems. While classical systems use bits to store information in the form of a zero or a one, quantum computers use qubits, storing information as a zero, a one, or both. With the ability to scale up exponentially, these qubits can tackle problems better and faster than current methods.

While quantum computing hasn't yet reached the stage of being broadly useful, it may reach that goal in the coming years. Tech giants such as Alphabet and International Business Machines are involved in the quantum computing race, and so are smaller companies, ones that specialize in this technology.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

And that leads me to the subject of IonQ (NYSE: IONQ) and Rigetti Computing (NASDAQ: RGTI), two pure plays that are making great progress in the space and already generate revenue thanks to their quantum computing platforms. Which is the better one to own for the next five years? Let's find out.

The case for IonQ

IonQ uses trapped ion technology to produce its qubits, and this involves transforming an atom into an ion, holding it in place with an electromagnetic force, and using lasers to manipulate the ion as part of the calculation process. The company doesn't use just one qubit, but many, and one of its main goals is scaling up. This year, it unveiled its 256-qubit computer and aims to grow this to two million qubits by 2030.

Last year, IonQ reached a significant milestone, achieving 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity for a world record in quantum computing error correction. This is key because accuracy is a challenge in quantum computing, and error correction is a main point of focus for all companies involved in the field. Accuracy is a strength of the trapped ion method, though it isn't as fast as the superconducting technique used by Rigetti.

IonQ is experiencing tremendous growth, as we can see through its latest earnings report. In the second quarter, revenue soared 287% to $80 million. And this was driven by a record number of quantum computing deployments.

The case for Rigetti

Rigetti, as mentioned, uses the superconducting technique, etching superconducting materials on a silicon chip. This method is known for its speed, with Rigetti's Cepheus-1-108Q operating at a 60-nanosecond gate speed, but accuracy falls short of that achieved by the trapped ion method.

Story Continues

Another Rigetti strength is its vertical integration, producing its own chips and offering them to customers through its own cloud and public cloud service providers. This offers the company more control over costs and the production timelines for its hardware.

Like IonQ, Rigetti already is serving customers -- in fact, it's been offering quantum computers through the cloud since 2017. In the latest quarter, Rigetti's revenue soared 185%, so growth is strong, but the revenue level of about $5 billion is significantly lower than that of IonQ. And one particular risk is that more than 90% of Rigetti's revenue comes from government contracts.

Rigetti, however, may be positioned for significant growth and accomplishments in the next few years. It recently said it's on track to operate systems of 1,000 qubits, at about 99.9% two-qubit gate fidelity, and at gate speeds of less than 50 nanoseconds in the coming three years.

Which quantum pure play is the better buy?

Both of these players are making significant progress in quantum computing and may score a win over the long run. There is room for more than one company and technique to become successful. And both of these stocks have fallen more than 30% so far this year, offering investors interesting buying opportunities .

But the better buy for the coming five years may be IonQ. The company offers less risk than Rigetti, has demonstrated impressive growth in recent times, and has a strong balance sheet with $3 billion in cash to power future growth. So there's reason to be optimistic about this exciting quantum pure play over next few years and beyond.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 14x Bigger

Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005.

But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout, a massive technology build-out that Google's CEO says could be more profound than fire or electricity.

While everyone watches the chip designers, one "backbone" company provides the critical technology that Nvidia and AMD literally cannot function without. We've detailed this under-the-radar player in our new AI Playbook.

Continue »

news.Title: Worried About an AI Bubble? This ETF Could Be the Smartest Buy Right Now
news.Content:
Do you think the AI trade has pushed the S&P 500 's (SNPINDEX: ^GSPC) largest stocks to dangerously elevated valuations? Do you still want broad equity exposure without abandoning the market entirely? If you answered "yes" to both questions, one exchange-traded fund (ETF) solves that problem more elegantly than almost any alternative.

The Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight ETF (NYSEMKT: RSP) owns the same 500 companies as the S&P 500. The difference is in how it weights them. Instead of allocating more to the largest companies by market capitalization, this fund gives each of the index's holdings an approximately equal weight of around 0.2%.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 16x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

That single structural difference produces a dramatically different risk profile. In the current market environment, the Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight ETF could be the smartest buy right now.

The concentration problem

The so-called "Magnificent Seven" stocks -- Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL), Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA), Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOG) (NASDAQ: GOOGL), Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN), Meta Platforms (NASDAQ: META), and Tesla (NASDAQ: TSLA) -- account for around one-third of the S&P 500's total market capitalization. That means a passive investor in the State Street SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (NYSEMKT: SPY) or Vanguard S&P 500 ETF (NYSEMKT: VOO) has more than 30 cents of every dollar concentrated in only seven stocks, most of which trade at relatively high valuations.

The Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight ETF solves this mechanically. By attempting to give nearly equal weights to each holding, it reduces the Magnificent Seven's combined weight to 1.37% of the total portfolio. An investor who buys the ETF still owns Nvidia, Apple, and Microsoft -- just in roughly the same proportions as Coca-Cola (NYSE: KO), Johnson & Johnson (NYSE: JNJ), and Chevron (NYSE: CVX).

The valuation difference between the two approaches is equally striking. The cap-weighted S&P 500 trades at a Shiller CAPE (cyclically adjusted price-to-earnings) ratio of 40.7 -- near its second-highest reading in 155 years. However, the equal-weighted version trades at a significantly lower multiple, because the extreme valuations of the largest stocks are diluted across 500 equally weighted positions.

A trade-off worried investors might be willing to make

Story Continues

Over most 10-year periods that included a sustained mega-cap technology bull market, the Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight ETF has underperformed the S&P 500. Investors who believe the AI trade has further to run will capture less upside than with a cap-weighted alternative.

But for investors genuinely worried about AI bubble risk, the Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight ETF offers something most hedging strategies don't: continued full participation in the broad U.S. economy without the concentrated bet on the most expensive market leadership in modern history. At a 0.20% expense ratio, the insurance it provides against concentration risk has rarely been cheaper relative to the risk it hedges.

news.Title: 華邦電看明後年供需維持緊張，砸731億元續擴產
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-03 17:23:58 周佩宇 發佈

華邦電(2344)今(3)日召開法說會，總經理陳沛銘(附圖中)看好記憶體供需持續緊俏，第四季客製化記憶體（CMS）合約價格仍有上漲空間，同時高容量NOR Flash價格上行趨勢可望延續至明(2027)年；他並指出，業界普遍認為2027年供需將比2026年更緊，2028年可能維持相近程度。

華邦電第三季合併營收823.31億元、季增37.6%，毛利率70.6%、季增逾4個百分點，歸屬母公司稅後淨利354.22億元、季增45.7%，每股盈餘7.58元；前三季累計每股盈餘15.32元。董事會今日也通過上半年度股利政策，每股將配發2元現金股利。

產品方面，第三季CMS營收季增50%、占合併營收58%，混合平均售價季增近60%，位元出貨量則季減高個位數百分比，20奈米DDR4、LPDDR4仍為主要成長動能；Flash營收季增34%、占比32%，位元出貨量季持平、混合平均售價季增約三成，其中24奈米營收貢獻提高，高容量NOR營收與出貨占比同步創高。展望2027年，高容量NOR供給持續吃緊，SLC NAND亦有新案導入支撐價格；AI伺服器、車用及基礎架構需求延續，DDR3、DDR4缺貨也帶來過去未有合作的基礎架構客戶。

目前華邦電DRAM在PC與伺服器的銷售規模仍小，陳沛銘預期2027年將明顯成長，尤其看好伺服器需求，電腦應用占記憶體營收比重可望較第三季17%明顯提高；車用則是AI之外較有掌握的成長領域，客戶產品替換不易，長期供貨需求持續。

為因應長期需求，華邦電董事會通過731億元資本支出案，主要投入高雄廠Module B建設與設備，預計12月底動土，目標兩年內完成裝機，無塵室規劃月產能5萬至6萬片。高雄廠既有Module A產能已滿，2027年、2028年月產能維持約2.4萬片，在新產能到位前，公司須提前保留部分產品與庫存，以履行長期供貨安排，Module B長期供貨協議（LTA）也持續洽談。

製程升級方面，16奈米已開始放量，預期2027年帶來顯著營收貢獻，陳沛銘看好2027年下半年占比進一步提高；2027年產品仍聚焦DDR4、LPDDR4，並持續供應DDR3，滿足車用、工業等客戶長期需求。

其他布局方面，CUBE進度如期，預計2027年進入量產並逐步增加產能；收購英飛凌NOR Flash與F-RAM事業案，則待取得主管機關核准，預計2027年下半年完成交割，交易後將以Spansion為名維持獨立營運，保有自身銷售與設計團隊。對整體市況，華邦電仍留意通膨、利率對消費支出及傳統電子需求的影響，但認為AI需求持續支撐記憶體上升循環，自身獲利動能維持強勁，經營上將重視長期供貨關係，而非單純追求最高價格。

(圖:資料庫)

news.Title: 第19座科學園區在台南! 外界估台積電1奈米可能落腳
news.Content: 財經中心／楊思敏、洪國凱　台北報導 全台灣目前有18座科學園區，國科會主委吳誠文透露，明年將會有第19座誕生，地點就在台南，要為一奈米晶圓廠做準備。外界就解讀，有能力量產一奈米的，就只有台積電，而先前台積電也揭露，已經在準備A14製程產能，預計明年就會進入風險試產。 台積電先進製程獨步全球，二奈米在高雄，三奈米在台南量產，生產重鎮都在南科，前八個月營業額2.49兆，年增36.5%，再創新高。國科會主委吳誠文透露，要在台南開發新園區，為一奈米晶圓廠做準備。 國科會主委吳誠文：「現在有18座（科學園區），明年會有一座新的，非常大的科學園區在台南，正在為1奈米晶圓廠做準備，我們將在明年啟動相關程序。」 外界推測，台積電一奈米可能落腳台南。（圖／台積電） 雖然沒直接點名，但外界解讀，現在有能力生產一奈米的，就只有台積電，最先進的一奈米製程，極有可能落腳台南，10月中，台積電法說會也透露A14進展。 聲源：台積電董事長暨總裁魏哲家（10.15）：「我們已開始為A14準備產能，預計2027年進行風險試產，進度完全按計畫進行，2028年開始量產。」 台積電A14製程預計2028年量產。（圖／民視財經網） 吳誠文強調，政府協助整合土地、水資源和基礎設施，為產業助一臂之力，全台目前有18個科學園區，加上明年要推動的台南大型園區，總共會有19座。 國科會主委吳誠文：「我們規劃與開發的科學園區，主要用於半導體，但還有生物醫療產業，光電產業以及精密機械。」 期待利用半導體優勢，帶動其他產業發展，讓台灣跟著這波AI浪潮，一起乘風破浪。

news.Content:

中國A股主要指數今(3)日收低，上證指數收於3,608.10點，下跌0.82%，日K翻黑；深證成指收於10,876.99點，下跌1.21%；創業板指收於2,391.65點，下跌2.73%；科創50收於1,151.28點，下跌3.81%。盤勢偏弱，科技成長與算力硬體成為拖累大盤的主要壓力。

成交量方面，滬市今日成交8,108億元(人民幣,下同)，深市成交8,926億元，兩市成交額1兆7,034億元，較前一交易日量縮約4%。

盤面上，算力硬體、CPO、半導體與科創板個股明顯走弱，中際旭創、天孚通信、寒武紀等表現疲弱，光通訊、光模組、光晶片與GPU相關族群同步承壓。科創50跌幅擴大，反映硬科技權重股調整對指數拖累較重。

弱勢盤勢下，AI漫劇、短劇與部分傳媒概念相對活躍，文投控股、掌閱科技、浙文影業等表現突出。資金在高彈性題材間快速切換，盤中輪動節奏明顯加快。

此外，電池族群維持強勢，盟固利、豐元股份、野馬電池、寧德時代等走強，帶動創業板相關權值回穩。市場也受到全固態電池材料與長時儲能落地預期支撐。

同時，中船系、海洋經濟與水產方向走強，昆船智能、中國動力等活躍。整體來看，今日A股呈現指數走弱、題材分化的格局，成長族群內部的強弱差距進一步拉大。

news.Title: 華邦電法說會》記憶體下半年恐供不應求？總座：第四季營運成長恐放緩
news.Content:
記憶體廠華邦電（2344）今（3）日召開法說會，總經理陳沛銘指出，市場普遍預期2027年記憶體缺貨狀況恐比今年更嚴重，且下半年緊縮力道將強於上半年。

陳沛銘指出，當前產業景氣呈現嚴重的「AI強、非AI弱」分化現象，第四季消費性需求已出現修正，甚至有客戶直言PC做三季累了，「第四季要休息」，預期公司第四季營運雖能保持成長，但增長力道將不如前幾季強勁。

有法人關心，AI有沒有泡沫化？陳沛銘坦言，市場確實開始審視雲端服務商（CSP）的融資狀況與投資回收期，但他強調「AI發展趨勢已經無法逆轉」，未來將持續扮演支撐記憶體強勁需求的核心引擎。

陳沛銘特別透露，輝達（NVIDIA）最新的伺服器機櫃中，單一機櫃可能使用超過600顆Flash（快閃記憶體），且多集中在512Mb、1Gb及2Gb等高容量產品。華邦電在此領域市占率已突破6成、甚至有機會衝上7成。另一方面，企業級SSD的高速成長也同步拉動DRAM需求，預計到2027年，電腦（Computer）相關應用的營收比重將大幅顯著提升。

面對供需吃緊，陳沛銘強調，華邦電不會一味追求最高價格，而是會優先支持長期合作夥伴。

他舉例，有些中小客戶每個月雖然僅需要幾百片DRAM，但「只要缺了這幾百片，整間公司運作可能就斷料停擺」，即使是年營收高達兩、三百億元的大廠，也可能因微量記憶體短缺而陷入出貨危機。因此，華邦電已特地預留部分產能給簽署長約的客戶，確保供應鏈穩定。

news.Title: 華邦電Q3賺逾354億，擴廠步調加快，啟動高雄Module B設置
news.Content:
【財訊快報／記者李純君報導】受惠於漲價效益持續擴大，本土記憶體製造商華邦電(2344)第三季毛利率超過七成，單季賺進354.22億元，單季每股淨利7.58元。此外，公司也宣布加大投資，董事會今（3）日通過731.63億元資本支出案，投入高雄Module B擴產，2029年下半小量產出，2030年規劃單月最大產出達5到6萬片。華邦電第三季財報，單季合併營收達823.31億元，季增37.6%、年增278.2%，毛利率70.6%，季增4.4個百分點，單季歸屬母公司稅後淨利354.22億元，第三季每股淨利7.58元；累計2026年前三季每股淨利15.32元。

後續展望，總經理陳沛銘點出，AI獨強，但消費性修正。此外，公司記憶體事業2026年全年資本支出計畫約395億元，前三季累計已支出234億元。現有產能部分，高雄廠Module A在今年第三季月產能約1.6萬片，到2026年底月產能將拉升至2.4萬片，預計2027年至2028年將維持2.4萬片滿載運作。而公司董事會通過731.63億元資本支出案，投入高雄Module B擴產，規劃今年底辦動工，2029年下半小量產出，2030年規劃單月最大產出達5到6萬片。

另外，華邦電在今年9月16日宣布以11.2億美元現金，收購德國英飛凌（Infineon）旗下的NOR Flash與F-RAM事業100%股權一案，公司提到，現在正向美國、中國、日本、歐盟及台灣等多國監管機構申請審查，若順利，公司規劃在2027年下半年取得營運控制權，並使用原品牌名稱「Spansion」。

news.Title: 投資人只注意到科技股大跌 但美股多數股票仍上漲
news.Content:
美國股市周一(2日)原本早盤急漲後，漲勢快速瓦解，人工智慧(AI)與科技股在上周遭拋售之後持續疲軟，成為市場焦點，從而掩蓋了華爾街多數股票的漲勢。

在指數表現方面，標普500指數早盤一度上揚1.1%，但隨後回吐全部漲幅，終場下跌0.5%或38.67點，收於7,541.40點；那斯達克綜合指數下挫1.1%或272.68點，收25,164.32點；道瓊指數逆勢上漲213點或0.4%，收51,983.98點。

儘管主要指數走勢分化，標普500指數成分股中仍有近七成上漲，主要受惠於布蘭特原油期貨價格大跌7.6%至每桶104.77美元，緩解了企業燃料成本壓力。原油價格自伊朗戰爭爆發前至今，持續在每桶70至120美元之間大幅震盪。

科技族群則面臨高度不確定性。市場持續擔憂大型科技公司投入數千億美元建設AI資料中心，恐難以實現相應的生產力與獲利效益。Alphabet(GOOGL-US)因自由現金流減少及搜尋業務成長放緩，引發市場對AI削弱核心獲利的疑慮，股價在上周四暴跌逾12%，創歷來最大單日跌幅，周一雖一度開高2.6%，終場仍轉跌0.3%。

晶片巨頭輝達(NVDA-US)早盤一度上漲2.6%，最終仍收低1.3%。此外，Marvell Technology(MRVL-US)宣布將以換股方式收購AI光學元件廠Lumentum(LITE-US)，導致Marvell股價重挫12.7%，Lumentum更暴跌18.6%。

相較於科技股走低，傳統產業與航空旅遊類股表現強勁。聯合航空(UAL-US)大漲4.8%，西南航空(LUV-US)上漲3.6%，嘉年華郵輪(CCL-US)上漲4.2%。

針對這波市場輪動，Nationwide 首席市場策略師Mark Hackett 表示，雖然指數表面平穩，但底層波動劇烈

；若科技股連續數月劇烈下跌，不論在數學計算或市場心理上都將變得非常困難。

Edward Jones 資深全球投資策略師Angelo Kourkafas 指出，投資人希望維持持股，但正試圖降低AI集中度風險，轉向多元收益來源。但他警告，若超大規模雲端業者（hyperscalers）開始削減支撐經濟的資本支出，恐引發廣泛的避險情緒。

news.Title: 外資史上第八大賣超砍出台股第七大跌點！「電金」綠油油 資安股亮一排紅燈成避風港｜Yahoo財經掃描
news.Content:
電子金融齊倒，台股重挫1612點、失守4萬4！今(3)日加權指數終場下跌1,612.60點、跌幅3.59%，收43,307.54點，創史上第七大單日收盤跌點，指數持續位於周線、月線之下，成交金額9,301.54億元。市場對AI投資回報與估值的疑慮未消，加上美國期中選舉及中東局勢增添不確定性，賣壓由大型權值股蔓延至中小型股，電子與金融類股分別下跌3.69%、2.54%，櫃買指數更重挫6.42%。

台積電(2330)終場下跌35元、跌幅1.50%，收2,295元，失守2,300元關卡；聯發科(2454)重挫7.43%、台達電(2308)下跌6.27%，鴻海(2317)也收低2.19%，權值股全面承壓。記憶體族群受到鎧俠獲利展望不如預期影響，南亞科(2408)、華邦電(2344)雙雙跌停；光通訊族群同樣重挫，穩懋(3105)鎖跌停，聯亞(3081)、光聖(6442)、華星光(4979)同樣亮綠燈；少數逆勢亮點則以台玻(1802)最受矚目，受惠財報與擴產利多，終場上漲6.28%，收67.7元。資服股也在資安年會及相關商機題材帶動下突圍，精誠金融(7819)、仁大資訊(7767)、全景軟體(8272)等攻上漲停，成為盤面少數紅光。

亞洲市場漲跌分歧，韓國綜合指數下跌3.59%，上海綜合指數下跌0.82%，香港恆生指數則逆勢上漲0.48%；日本則因文化日休市。

📝盤點熱門股：主動中信台灣收益、群益臺灣加權正2、元大台灣50正2

熱門成交榜前五名全由ETF包辦，且全數重挫收黑。主動中信台灣收益(00406A)以160.10萬張奪下爆量王，今日逢台股急殺，交投熱絡但賣壓沉重，終場失守8元；群益臺灣加權正2(00685L)、元大台灣50正2(00631L)也在大盤重挫下雙雙大跌，呈現量大價跌格局。

主動式ETF方面，第四名主動統一台股增長(00981A)、主動統一升級50(00403A)亦明顯走低，「瑤池金母」與「師弟」雙雙承壓，與正2ETF成為這波急跌中的交易焦點。

📌三大法人買賣超

三大法人今日合計賣超1464.57億元，其中，外資大舉賣超1073.07億元，砍出歷史第8大賣超紀錄，成為法人賣壓主力；投信逆勢買超199.05億元，自營商則賣超590.55億元。整體來看，外資與自營商同步大幅調節，僅投信站在買方，難抵銷其餘法人賣超力道。

✨本日議題股：台玻

台股重挫之際，台玻(1802)逆勢扮演「防彈玻璃」，盤中一度衝上70元漲停價，成交量突破26萬張，引來網友驚呼「是大盤反一嗎？」。這波強勢表現背後，有財報與擴產雙利多撐腰...... 點我看更多

👥存股資優生還能存嗎：

連續配息43年，昔日的「存股資優生」現在還能存嗎？台泥(1101)、亞泥(1102)雖有長年發放股利的紀錄，但水泥業正面臨房市疲弱、進口低價競爭，以及能源與減碳成本上升等壓力，穩定配息不代表獲利無虞...... 點我看更多

🔭重大財經事件展望

周三國際財經焦點，先看美國市場，將公布10月ADP小非農就業報告、服務業PMI指數終值與國際貿易數據，超微(AMD)、麥當勞(MCD)也將公布財報；歐洲方面，歐元區、法國、德國及英國將公布10月服務業PMI指數終值；亞太區方面，澳洲、韓國與印度也將公布10月服務業PMI指數終值，可望進一步勾勒區域景氣走向；陸港澳方面，標普與RatingDog將公布中國大陸10月服務業及綜合PM。

台灣方面，金管會主委彭金隆將出席金融資安韌性與戰略論壇，國泰投信AI投資地圖論壇、貝萊德ETF國際論壇及法國巴黎銀行財富管理全球CEO記者會也將登場，市場將關注AI投資趨勢與資產配置展望；此外，工研院IEK研討會開幕，童子賢將出席零碳永續論壇，公平會則將召開委員會議，國產署也有記者會。個股焦點包括亞德客-KY(1590)、國巨*(2327)、研華(2395)、友達(2409)與中華電(2412)法說會，營運展望與產業需求將成觀察重點；波力-KY(8467)則將除息。

news.Title: 台股慘遭血洗！專家曝「5大生存警訊」：還沒到跌了就買階段
news.Content: 近來台股慘遭血洗，今（3）日加權指數更大跌1613點，為史上第7大單日慘跌，失守44000點關卡，不少投資人被迫吐出獲利，但也有人「越跌越買」。對此，財經作家施昇輝提醒，「現在還不是跌了就買的階段」，並列出5大問題，希望投資人審視一下自己的投資策略。 施昇輝在臉書粉專「 樂活分享人生 」發文表示，2日晚上期貨盤又跌了超過900點，其實是在補跌2日早上大盤該大跌卻沒有大跌的部分。他認為從10月15日外資賣超3000億之後，一直都還沒到「跌了就買」的階段。 施昇輝也提醒，這時應該檢視5個問題，查看自己存股是否健康，如果答案都是「是」，就應該檢討一下自己的投資策略，問題如下: 1. 我是不是沒有錢進場了？ 2. 我是不是借錢來買股票？ 3. 我是不是沒上班了？ 4. 我的個股佔投資組合的比例是不是遠大於ETF？例如7:3、8:2、9:1？ 5. 我帳上的虧損是不是已經超過今年已實現的獲利？或是今年根本是賠的？ 不少網友表示，「都不是，我只有0056」、「都不是，繼續按照自己紀律前進」、「鐵粉，所以都不是，穩如泰山」、「我是鐵粉，5題都不是，感恩大叔」，但也有人說，「嗚嗚嗚太早進場花光錢了」、「很難虧錢，不過今天少了20萬好扯」、「是！買的時間點不對。」 台股今日開低走低，盤中最低一度來到43191.58點，終場下跌1612.60點，以43307.54點作收，跌幅3.59%，台積電今日也下跌來到2295元，跌幅1.5%。不只台股，新台幣匯率也再次走弱，新台幣兌美元盤中最低觸及32.8元，收盤收32.76元。 三立新聞網提醒您：

news.Title: 2026台灣週總統親到場揭幕 蔡力行:快買我們家股票
news.Content: 財經中心／葉為襄、陳泊翰　台北報導 2026臺灣週是金管會推動臺灣成為「亞洲資產管理中心」的重要金融盛會，11/3-11/13登場，今年以從科技島到資本島為主軸，規模再升級，45場活動聚焦七大主題，總統賴清德親自揭開序幕，聯發科執行長蔡力行專題演講當場喊，"快來買我們家股票"，東京證交所和美股那斯達克高層都在台下，瞄準台灣AI和半導體實力。 台上金曲歌手舒米恩，原民歌聲響徹會場，台下國際金融巨頭聽得如癡如醉，2026台灣週登場，今年規模更勝以往。 2026台灣週登場！　聯發科蔡力行開講「快來買我們家股票」。(圖/民視財經網) 總統賴清德表示主計總處上週五公布，今年第三季經濟成長率是14.36%，比8月預測數據增加2.94%，創下48年來同季最高。 金管會主委彭金隆致詞提到這實質反映在台股加權指數以及市值上，2025年10月底，台股指數28000點市值98兆，到今年10月底，指數來到4萬5000點，台股總市值成長到158兆，成長超過61%。 台灣週邁入第二屆，11/3-11/13為期11天，今年以從科技島到資本島為主軸，規模再升級，規劃45場活動聚焦七大主題，涵蓋亞洲資產管理、AI金融創新，東京證交所社長橫山隆介、那斯達克執行副董EdwardKnight和聯發科執行長蔡力行都到場開講，總統賴清德大展GDP好成績，講給台下國際巨頭聽。 台灣股市地位，躍升全球第4，市值破158兆台幣，台積電和聯發科功不可沒。聯發科執行長蔡力行表示各位投資我們公司要有耐心，順帶一提你們可真的要非常有耐心，所以我也非常鼓勵各位，多多買進我們公司的股票，拜託大家了。 蔡力行化身最大咖SALES，當眾向國際資本市場喊話，台灣的野心不只身為AI中心，還要成為亞洲資金匯聚的重要樞紐。

news.Title: Intel Stock's October Was Its Worst Month Since at Least 1980. History Says What Can Come Next.
news.Content: Intel (NASDAQ:INTC) stock closed October at $65.76, down 45% from its $120.23 close at the end of September. Yahoo Finance's daily price data for the company begins in March 1980, and no other month in it was worse. That makes October Intel's worst month since at least 1980. Most of the loss came in one session. Shares dropped 29% on Oct. 30, the day after Intel's third-quarter results, as management forecast just $0.25 in fourth-quarter non-GAAP (adjusted) earnings per share ...
news.AI_Summary:
• Intel experienced its worst month since at least 1980 in October, with shares down 45%.
• The sharp decline followed a Q3 earnings report where management forecast Q4 non-GAAP EPS of $0.25, less than half of Q3's $0.52.
• Historical analysis of Intel's worst months shows a mixed record for subsequent 12-month performance, with some periods showing declines.
• Despite a weakening PC market, Intel's data center and AI segment revenue grew 78% year-over-year in Q3.
• However, profit is expected to decline, and the PC slowdown is anticipated to continue through the first half of next year.
news.Keywords: earnings miss, forward guidance, PC market, data center growth, profit decline

news.Title: 台股史上第7大跌點！專家「四貸同堂壓力山大」　網喊：1年被收割2次
news.Content:
台股今（3）日終場收43,307.54點，下跌1,612.60點，跌幅3.59%，跌破44,000點整數關卡，距離43,000點僅剩307點。對此，財經專家股魚提到，現在台股情況，會讓四貸同堂的投資人壓力山大，且不用主管機關出手，市場就被迫降槓桿了。

觀看台股今日開盤後一路震盪走低，盤中因追價力道反攻未成，終場大跌1,612.60點，以43,307.54點作收，跌幅達3.59%，並一口氣跌破44,000點大關，寫下歷史上收盤第七大跌點紀錄。市場成交值放大至9,280.58億元。

半導體與大型科技股方面，沉重賣壓最終仍波及亞股，導致今日大盤一片綠油油，櫃買指數同步重挫6.42%，收在345.52點。指標台股，台積電（2330）今日收2295元，跌幅1.50%，連續四個交易日下跌5.36%。

股魚在臉書發文直言，台股下跌1600點，四貸同堂的投資人壓力山大，不用主管機關出手，市場就被迫降槓桿了。持有現股壓力大，融資槓桿的更大。

此篇貼文一出，許多網友留言，「昨天融資減少得太少了，被外資修理只是剛好」、「從10月初開始，拉高就是空點

直到今天還是空點，一直不是很樂觀」、「好慘，一年被收割兩次，恐怖片」、「有機會可以挑戰4萬點了嗎」、「去年賺的2個月就賠掉了、股票不是平凡人玩的」、「去年一堆人進進出出忙了快一年到底賺了多少？」還有人說，「來不及跑了，直接開炸了」。

news.Title: 全球市場關注…美期中選舉三劇本牽動股市 台股基本面有撐
news.Content:
美國期中選舉將於美國時間11月3日登場，美國國會版圖是否重新洗牌，牽動全球金融市場敏感神經。瀚亞投信表示，選舉結果可能帶動股市短線波動，但從中長期來看，投資仍應回歸基本面，待選舉不確定性逐步消化後，企業獲利、通膨、利率與籌資成本仍將是左右市場走勢的關鍵。 近期台股震盪，但基本面仍具支撐，惟仍待短線籌碼沉澱、不確定因素降低，後續則可觀察美股及日、韓股市止穩程度。

瀚亞投信國內投資部主管姚宗宏表示，本次美國期中選舉可從三種情境觀察。若兩黨各掌國會一院，政策形成制衡，對金融市場影響相對有限，美股可望較快回歸基本面；若執政黨共和黨續掌兩院，政策延續性提高，短線市場反應可能較為正面，但中期仍須觀察後續政策方向及其對通膨、利率的影響。

若民主黨拿下兩院，姚宗宏認為，則須分別從短期與中長期觀察。短期而言，市場可能擔憂對人工智慧（AI）監管力道升高，使科技與AI相關類股面臨壓力；然而中長期來看，國會制衡力量若因此提高，或許有助降低地緣政治、油價及通膨風險，企業營運與籌資成本也可能獲得改善，因此不排除呈現「短空長多」格局。 若相關監管疑慮已提前反映於股價，選後甚至可能出現利空逐步消化的契機。

姚宗宏進一步指出，近期美股表現相對亞洲股市落後，市場真正關注的不全然是選舉結果，而是利率走勢、企業現金流及籌資成本。尤其市場重新調整對貨幣政策的預期後，企業資金成本與科技股評價受到壓力；待選舉落幕、利率與通膨疑慮逐步消化後，市場焦點仍有機會重新回到企業獲利與基本面。

回到台股，姚宗宏認為，台灣企業基本面相對強勁，因此近期國際股市修正過程中，台股回檔幅度也相對有限。不過，短線籌碼仍有待進一步沉澱。

展望後市，姚宗宏表示，台股短線較可能持續震盪，後續可持續觀察美股及日、韓股市的止穩程度。近期日、韓股已有觸底回彈跡象，若國際市場延續回升趨勢，加上選舉、利率及通膨等不確定因素逐步消化，台股有望重新回歸企業獲利與基本面表現，並為年底至明年的行情累積動能。

news.Title: 台股暴跌連連破底！現在是接刀還是撿鑽石？分析師說三個字...
news.Content:
台股3日開低走低，盤中大跌逾千點，近幾日每天都是破底的表現，大盤跌個不停，投資人心慌慌，都在問到底該怎麼辦？證券分析師坦言，大盤未止穩，「只能等」，重要的關鍵因素則是新台幣能不能止貶，不過，分析師也強調，已有打底跡象的個股及族群，可以逐步建立小部位。

美股科技股賣壓延續，費城半導體指數周一續挫3.37%，記憶體族群與台股ADR全面收黑，台股3日以44,481.59點開出，下跌438.55點，台積電（2330）、日月光投控（3711）、南亞（1303）、台達電（2308）、南亞科（2408）、欣興（3037）、台光電（2383）、聯電（2303）、台塑化（6505）等個股同步走低，拖累大盤指數一度下滑至43,355.41點，大跌1,564.73點。

統計台股今年來的三次下跌走勢，2月至3月的美伊戰事衝擊，大盤指數由35,579.34點下跌至31,705.99點，下跌3,873.35點，跌幅10.88%；7月間的那波修正則是由48,218.87點下跌至39,384.85點，大跌8,834.02點，跌幅18.32%；本波由歷史新高的49,968.92點下跌至盤中低點43,355.41點，下跌6,613.51點，跌幅13.23%。

證券分析師張張浩表示，新台幣貶值，台股今年在全球股市中相對強勢，外資持續賣超提款，加上投資人居高思危，先行獲利落袋，在每天都破底的情況下，出現多殺多，也讓大盤後市更不好預測。

張陳浩認為，市場目前對AI資本支出投入能否回收存有疑慮，也在評估對AI的估值是否高估？他指出，個人認為AI的需求及成長都相當明顯，AI沒有出現泡沫，但在新台幣持續貶值，外資賣超不斷下，現在沒有「穩」的跡象，要先觀察指數能不能止穩。

張陳浩直言，新台幣能不能止貶是重要的關鍵，現在的操作要有耐心，「只能等」，靜待盤穩；不過，他強調，已有打底跡象的三個族群可以逐步建立小部位，其中包括散熱的奇鋐（3017）、雙鴻（3324）、健策（3653）；CCL的台光電，玻纖布及玻纖紗的台玻（1802）、富喬（1815）、德宏（5475）、金居（8358）；ABF的欣興、南電（8046）、景碩（3189）都可以留意。

news.Title: 台股血洗11月 半導體ETF受益人數卻突破60萬人創新高
news.Content:
根據集保結算所統計至10月30止，台股六檔半導體ETF中，合計受益人數突破60萬人次、創歷史新高，為連續第五周人數正成長，且高達五檔半導體ETF受益人數同步創高。儘管半導體市況低迷、股市熱度冷卻，法人認為，股市漲時重勢、跌時重質，如遇大盤急跌，應越挫越勇，鎖定績優ETF分批撿便宜。

分析師表示，3日台股再創波段新低，投資氣圍轉趨保守，市場靜待融資減肥及外資轉賣為買，不過受到摩根士丹利首度執行長Ted Pick表示，未來十年全球AI資本支出恐達10兆至15兆美元，認為AI投資部署，僅處於棒球九局比賽的第二局，AI資料中心的投資回報將具有持久性，AI帶來的人類生產力革命，也可使美國每年實際國內生產毛額（GDP）增長50至70個基點，大大激勵投信六檔半導體ETF，市場買氣持續發燒。

根據CMoney統計至10月30日止，國內投信發行六檔台股半導體ETF中，最新受益人數合計突破60萬人；觀察各檔ETF人氣表現，則以台新臺灣IC設計（00947）、台新臺灣半導體30（00904）、中信關鍵半導體（00891）、群益半導體收益（00927）以及兆豐台灣晶圓製造（00913）等五檔，10月30日受益人數同創新高；績效方面，受益人數創新高的五檔半導體ETF，近兩年報酬率也都突破100%，績效翻倍成長，顯示半導體ETF長線大有可為，投資人有機會越抱越香。

台新臺灣半導體30ETF經理人黃鈺民表示，10月美股出現明顯類股輪動，道瓊漲、標普500和那指同步收黑，費半單月更狂跌超過15%，這突顯半導體和AI供應鏈，面臨獲利預期及估值的雙重調整壓力，但預估選後政治風險降低，將有利於資金回流，目前美台兩地半導體股價修正，已逐步反映政治風險、美債殖利率高檔衝擊，中長期股價將受惠AI產業趨勢成長、企業獲利成長支撐，驅動半導體股的結構性多頭仍可期待。

根據歷史統計，美期中選舉前，股市易受不確定干擾，大盤表現震盪，但期中選舉後1年，股市長期報酬受企業獲利、景氣循環驅動，而非政治版面變動，多數仍呈現走揚格局，另外聯準會若採取「緩升息」政策，股市通常表現會較「強升息」時期佳，由於聯準會10月利率政策按兵不動，預料未來激進升息空間有限，表示現階段美國升息環境仍處於緩升息階段，加上11月美國期中選舉結束後，新政局版面確定，市場不確定風險消除，有助於資金重新聚焦基本面，台股AI半導體供應鏈基本面展望持續正向，中長期展望仍大有可為。

投資建議上，台新臺灣半導體30 ETF投資團隊表示，台灣半導體供應鏈長期受惠AI資本支出擴張、新一代AI晶片平台放量、企業級AI應用普及等三大動能，建議投資人11月布局台股不躁進，可分批布局鎖定高技術門檻的AI或半導體硬體龍頭股，或掌握半導體ETF作產業上中下游完整配置，捕捉中長線成長題材釣大魚。

news.Title: 華邦電第三季EPS 7.58元  擬砸731億「做這事」
news.Content:
記憶體廠華邦電（2344）今（3）日舉行法說會，華邦電第三季單季合併營收達823.31億元，季增37.6%、年增278.2%；毛利率達70.6%，季增4.4個百分點；營益率來到53.2%，季增4.8個百分點；稅後盈餘354.22億元，季增45.7%，每股稅後盈餘7.58元。

受惠於記憶體漲價潮，華邦電前3季合併營收1804.27億元，年增187.39%；稅後盈餘698.53億元，年增16倍，每股稅後盈餘15.32元，其中，記憶體事業記憶體事業毛利率季增近3%、衝上73.9%；產能利用率逼近100％，為營運成長的關鍵核心。

自由現金流部分，華邦電表示，單季營業活動現金淨流入458.68億元，扣除資本支出159.48億元後，自由現金流達299.20億元；華邦電也在會中公布，自今年11月起將投入731億6300萬元，作為南科高雄園區12吋晶片廠的擴建與設備更新，希望藉由擴建來支援公司長期發展與市場需求。

股價部分，華邦電受大盤重挫影響，早盤以157.5元開出，後續一路下滑遭打入跌停價146元亮燈，成交量來到8.8萬張。

news.Title: 台股1600點崩盤不要慌！散戶操作、反彈訊號一次看清楚
news.Content:
由於台股今（3日）暴跌1612點寫下史上第七大跌點，引發散戶投資人恐慌，分析師建議投資人降低槓桿比重，並利用2大關鍵指標判斷後市反彈能否成形。

後市賣壓仍重 外資成最大殺手

摩爾投顧分析師何基鼎於Youtube頻道中指出，台股這次下跌的原因主要是外資匯出，美國正在進行期中選舉，市場預期會出現較大幅度的波動。操作建議上，台股接連跌破季線與半年線，何基鼎坦言短線上賣壓確實會比較大，首先應該先降低槓桿。

何基鼎表示，保持觀望態度手握現金，如果打算低接也應該慢慢買分批布局，因為長期來看股市都是偏多的，且過往美股在期中選舉過後，上漲的機率比較高，且第四季本來就是多頭季節，台積電營收沒有變差，股價也沒有破底。

何基鼎認為，今天比較可惜的是一些維持在高檔的個股也跟著被殺下來，但依然看多股市長期趨勢，投資人不要慌張。

操作建議、反彈訊號一次整理

摩爾投顧分析師林漢偉則提到，台股後市想要反彈的2大關鍵在於，選後油價能否持續回落，若油價進一步走低，有助減輕通膨與成本壓力，但跌破100美元，也不能直接消除AI融資疑慮，還要觀察利率與資金環境。

另外，林漢偉呼籲投資人留意AI投資信心能否修復，科技巨頭的訂單能否轉成營收？營運現金流能否支應擴建？市場需要看見具體進展，買盤才更有機會持續回流。

操作上，林漢偉建議耐心觀察訊號出現，包括利空出現，股價是否不再破底；反彈時，成交量是否配合；電子主流，能否帶頭連續走強，等到訊號逐步確認，才有提高布局比重的依據。

news.Title: 台股狂崩6700點還沒跌完？今爆人踩人慘劇 專家曝「這訊號」才是翻身關鍵
news.Content:
受到美國期中選舉不確定性與科技股暴跌影響，台股今（3）日賣壓全面出籠，加權指數開低走低，終場重挫1612點，跌幅3.59%，創台股史上第7大跌點，收在43307點，失守4萬4千點關卡，成交值達9280億元。上市櫃合計1790家下跌、74家公司跌停。財經作家狄驤指出，44000點重要支撐失守後，主力棄守引發人踩人行情，後續能否出現逢低加碼機會，關鍵之一在於融資是否進一步大減。

權值股全面帶頭走弱

今日盤面由大型權值股帶頭修正，台積電終場下跌35元，收2295元，跌幅1.50%；鴻海下跌5.5元，收245.5元，跌幅2.19%；聯發科重挫295元，收3675元，跌幅7.43%；台達電也下跌85元，收1270元，跌幅6.27%。

記憶體族群也難逃賣壓，華邦電、南亞科亮燈跌停，群聯同樣跌停，旺宏、力積電、威剛跌幅也超過5%。光通訊族群同步走弱，美國光通訊大廠邁威爾（Marvell）宣布收購Lumentum，企業價值高達1150億美元，儘管併購規模驚人，兩家公司股價卻雙雙下跌逾10%，拖累台股相關族群表現。穩懋、全新、聯亞、華星光、光聖、訊芯-KY均跌停。

融資減幅遠落後大盤回檔

觀察籌碼變化，大盤指數自高點49968點下殺至今日低點 43191點，累計重挫6777點、回檔幅度高達13%；然而融資餘額從10月12日的6533億元降至11月2日的 6226億元，減幅僅約4.6%，顯示市場槓桿降幅有限，浮動籌碼尚未清理乾淨。

財經作家狄驤在臉書發文指出，自己觀察的逢低加碼訊號之一，就是融資多殺多。今年7月股災期間，融資餘額減少達千億元，但這一波僅減少數百億元，代表市場仍有不少槓桿部位，籌碼尚未充分沉澱。

他表示，台股今天出現人踩人行情，44000點的重要支撐一旦跌破，主力棄守便讓跌勢進一步擴大。接下來應持續觀察市場去槓桿的程度，對已做好資金準備的投資人而言，劇烈修正也可能帶來資產重新分配的機會。

狄驤也提醒，市場過熱時就應及早降低槓桿。這麼做可能錯失部分行情與獲利，但若滿手槓桿，一旦遇上去槓桿行情，投資人可能因資金壓力被迫出場，甚至失去後續參與市場的機會。他認為，市場始終反映人性，類似的劇烈波動未來仍可能發生，投資人能做的，就是盡可能逆人性操作，才能長久留在市場。

法人指出，目前籌碼面尚未清理乾淨，加權指數不排除持續回測42500至43000點。投資人此時應逢高減碼、調降持股水位，同時緊盯融資餘額能否降至5800億元以下，作為大盤落底參考訊號之一。

news.Title: 《韓股》AI疑慮拖累 KOSPI收跌3.59%
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-03 16:22:55 數位內容中心 發佈

韓股今(3)日收盤明顯轉弱，韓國KOSPI指數收於5648.79點，下跌210.29點或3.59%；韓國KOSDAQ指數收於704.39點，下跌29.97點或4.08%。盤勢自開低後一路擴大跌幅，主因是市場對AI資金調度與獲利能力的疑慮升溫，風險偏好明顯降溫。

市場對Oracle、Meta、Alphabet等大型科技企業的融資與支出壓力再度轉趨保守，連帶壓抑半導體與科技股表現。外界對Anthropic資本支出壓力的關注，也讓AI題材短線承壓，Samsung Electronics(005930.KS)、SK hynix(000660.KS)、Samsung Electro-Mechanics(009150.KS)、Naver(035420.KS)與Kakao(035720.KS)同步走弱，成為指數下挫的主要拖累。

KOSPI方面，下跌家數明顯多於上漲家數，Samsung Electronics、SK hynix、Samsung Electro-Mechanics、LG Energy Solution(373220.KS)與SK Square(402340.KS)回檔，僅Samsung Biologics(207940.KS)逆勢收高。

KOSDAQ方面，盤中跌勢一度擴大，午後仍未能收復失地。EcoPro(086520.KS)、EcoPro BM(247540.KS)、Jusung Engineering(036930.KS)、Wonik IPS(240810.KS)等多數走跌，僅Alteogen(196170.KS)小幅上漲，顯示中小型成長股也受到情緒拖累。

news.Title: 《美股主題週報》手術機器人—ISRG、SYK、MDT
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-03 16:14:13 數位內容中心 發佈

Intuitive Surgical（ISRG.US）

2026年第三季，Intuitive Surgical的da Vinci與Ion合計手術量年增15%，並維持全年da Vinci手術量成長14%至15%的展望。同期器械與配件營收增至18億美元，顯示本週主題仍是手術需求延續，且收入重心持續由高頻耗材驅動。

Stryker（SYK.US）

10月，Stryker宣布投資CMR Surgical4億美元，並取得Versius機器人的美國獨家經銷權。這是公司本週最明確的手術機器人訊號，重點不在骨科財報，而是將機器人布局從Mako延伸到軟組織手術平台。

Medtronic（MDT.US）

近期，Medtronic表示Hugo robotic surgery system已取得泌尿科手術相關美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）許可。公司同時提到Touch Surgery Aide也已獲FDA許可，顯示本週主軸是法規進展與數位手術工作流同步推進。

Zimmer Biomet（ZBH.US）

2026年AAHKS年會前，Zimmer Biomet表示將展示整合機器人、手術導航與資料驅動軟體的intelligent orthopedic surgery technologies。這項動作反映公司本週重點在骨科手術平台整合，而非單一機器人產品更新。

EASE Holdings

EASE Holdings BV近期取得AAFC Group Inc追加950萬美元股權投資，使總股權資本達2,400萬美元。公司以設備即服務模式提供手術機器人等高值設備，顯示本週主題也延伸到以租賃與託管方式擴大導入。

news.Title: 單季EPS飆7.58元毛利率衝破7成 華邦電再砸731億擴建高雄12吋廠
news.Content:
記憶體大廠華邦電3日召開第3季法說會，受惠記憶體漲價潮全面爆發，單季歸屬母公司稅後淨利狂飆至354.22億元，較去年同期翻揚12倍，每股盈餘（EPS）繳出7.58元成績，累計前3季EPS達15.32元；同日董事會也通過重磅投資案，拍板投入731.63億元擴建南科高雄園區12吋晶圓廠，為後續強勁需求提前布局。

財報顯示，華邦電第3季合併營收達823.31億元，季增37.6％、年增278.2％。受惠客製化記憶體（CMS）平均售價暴增近60％，帶動單季毛利率一舉衝上70.6％，營業利益率也跨過50％門檻來到53.2％，單季營業利益達437.84億元，年增10.8倍，繳出獲利倍數炸裂的成績單。其中，記憶體事業產能利用率逼近100％，成為推升營運的核心引擎。

看好市況熱度，華邦電自今年11月起將斥資731億6300萬元，推進高雄12吋廠的廠房興建與設備採購。華邦電執行副總經理范祥雲指出，記憶體供給緊俏態勢預計一路延續至2027年，第4季客製化記憶體合約價仍具續漲動能，高容量NOR Flash漲勢也將延燒至明年，未來將持續聚焦DDR4、LPDDR4等規格，16奈米製程也將逐步放量。

儘管台股3日遭遇重挫拖累華邦電股價跌停收在146元，但公司單季自由現金流達299.2億元、負債權益比降至0.49，財務體質維持穩健，在記憶體長線多頭循環支撐與巨額擴產加持下，中長期營運續航力依然充沛。
